items.title: a tiny closure witness earns its keep before a full closure controller exists
items.assumption: For the current DelayBasin import program, repeated pressure for explicit decisions, deprecations, and non-live object tracking is strong enough to justify one compact resolution witness and durable closure ledger even before a wider closure-state controller exists.
items.scope: cross-datacube archive-control imports beginning in rev0103
invalidation_triggers: A future pass shows the pattern only duplicated already-active DelayBasin law without adding recoverable closure value
A smaller cross-lane closure packet or wider controller replaces this assumption with direct closure-state law
A new comparison set fails to reproduce the same pressure for explicit closure across genuinely unrelated datacubes

items.title: cooled-admission state needs one durable queue before it can be judged honestly
items.assumption: Several unrelated datacubes apply explicit candidate, hold, ready, or review state in ways that genuinely pressure DelayBasin to operationalize cooled admission rather than leaving retrospective-write law as prose alone.
items.scope: cross-datacube archive-control imports beginning in rev0104
invalidation_triggers: A future pass shows the queue adds no recoverable truth beyond careful prose and the existing revision receipt
Later comparisons fail to show any meaningful difference between immediate admission and cooled adjudication under matched scrutiny
A smaller or different surface replaces RETROSPECTIVE-QUEUE.json as the honest minimal cooled-admission object

items.title: a tiny firebreak ledger earns its keep before a broader trace-role controller exists
items.assumption: Several unrelated datacubes separate stable public extracts from richer working or privileged traces strongly enough to justify operationalizing DelayBasin's existing reasoning-firebreak law with one tiny ledger and receipt witness before any broader trace controller exists.
items.scope: cross-datacube archive-control imports beginning in rev0105
invalidation_triggers: A future pass shows the firebreak ledger adds no recoverable truth beyond careful receipt prose
Later comparisons fail to reproduce any meaningful pressure for separating stable public extract from richer working trace surfaces
A smaller or different surface replaces FIREBREAK-LEDGER.json as the honest minimal firebreak object
